items.title: File Widerspruch against rehab rejection
items.quote: Gegen den Bescheid kann innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Widerspruch erhoben werden.
items.computation: The letter itself states: 'Der Bescheid gilt mit dem vierten Tag nach dem angegebenen Versandtag als bekannt gegeben.' The stated Versandtag is Samstag, 21.11.2026. Day 4 after posting (21.11.) = 25.11.2026 (Wed) — this is the date of deemed Bekanntgabe under § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X; this deemed-delivery day itself does not shift for weekends/holidays. The one-month Widerspruchsfrist (§ 84 Abs. 1 SGG) then runs under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB (day after delivery, i.e. 26.11.2026, not counted as day 1) and § 188 Abs. 2 BGB (ends on the day of the following month bearing the same number as the start day): one month after 25.11.2026 = 25.12.2026 (Fri). 25.12.2026 is Erster Weihnachtstag (public holiday) and 26.12.2026 is Zweiter Weihnachtstag (also a holiday), 27.12.2026 is a Sunday; under § 26 Abs. 3 SGB X / § 193 BGB the deadline moves to the next working day, which is Monday 28.12.2026. Holidays checked for the sender's seat (Hessen) as well as NW; 25.12 and 26.12 are nationwide holidays, so the result is the same regardless of region.

warnings: The letter is dated 18.11.2026 but states it was posted ('Versandt am') on Samstag, 21.11.2026 — a Saturday, which is unusual for an authority's post dispatch; the Widerspruch deadline was computed from the stated Versandtag as the letter's own Rechtsbehelfsbelehrung instructs, giving 28.12.2026. If the actual postmark differs, the deadline could shift by a few days, so sending the Widerspruch well before 28.12.2026 is advisable.
No printed name of the signatory is shown ('Im Auftrag' with no name), which is common for mass-produced Bescheide but worth double-checking.
